text:
alex: Quick proposal here — move the loader from index-first warmup to a phasewise hydration lifecycle for very large bundles (multi-T, >16 shards). Goal: reduce peak memory pressure at startup and make on-demand activation predictable. Thoughts?

maria: +1 on reducing OOM spikes. curious how you want to express phases in the bundle manifest. also: how does this affect canary rollouts? :thinking_face:

sam.b: main risk is tail latency when a request hits a cold layer. we should pair phasewise hydration with a cheap short-circuit model (quantized small model) as a fallback or a prefetch hint based on prefix frequency.

kai: can we avoid adding another magic field to manifests? prefer a small state machine + explicit activation hints so loaders don't need ad-hoc heuristics. e.g. hydration_state: ["meta", "kvcache", "layers/0..N"] and a policy: { "phase": "conservative|aggressive|on_demand" }

lina: agree with kai. telemetry must expose per-phase latency and evictions. otherwise we won't know if phasewise saved cost or just shifted latency. we should attach trace/span names like "hydrate:phase:layer-<n>"

alex: yeah — sketch of a tiny manifest addition i had in mind: 

```
{
  "bundle_id": "gptx-1.5t-v2",
  "hydration_policy": "phasewise",
  "phases": [
    { "name": "meta", "assets": ["config.json","vocab.bin"], "priority": 100 },
    { "name": "kvcache", "assets": ["kv_index"], "priority": 90 },
    { "name": "layers-0-31", "assets": ["shard-0","shard-1"], "priority": 70 },
    { "name": "layers-32-63", "assets": ["shard-2","shard-3"], "priority": 50 }
  ],
  "prefetch_hints": { "prefixes": ["/api/search","/chat/short"] }
}
```

alex: loader would hydrate phases in order, but keep a small in-memory index to route requests. if a request references a cold layer we either: 1) block with bounded timeout and serve error; 2) fallback to a smaller quantized model (policy-based); 3) stream-partial response while background hydrates.

maria: option 3 sounds user-friendly but tricky. streaming partial tokens from partially-hydrated kv/layers could give gibberish unless deterministic. maybe stream a short apology + fallback then retry once layer is ready.

sam.b: for (2) fallback to smaller model we need well-defined semantic compatibility. suggest a contract: smaller model must be pinned to bundle_id:compat:<level> and we expose a deterministic fallback mapping. also metric: percent-of-requests-falling-back.

lina: we must prioritize observability for fallback churn. new metric: hydration_fallback_rate + histogram of fallback latency. add an alert if > 0.5% sustained over 5m.

kai: implementation detail: loader API should add an explicit 'ensure_phase(phase_name, timeout_ms)' primitive instead of ad-hoc checks. that way runtime can offer different strategies (sync, async, prefetch-only) without changing bundle format.

alex: good call. API sketch: ensure_phase(name, strategy="block|async_prefetch|background", timeout_ms=2000). strategies map to behavior in manifest-level policies.

warmup-bot: perf-sim job for phasewise hydration (bundle=gptx-1.5t-v2, policy=conservative) finished: median cold-start latency +28ms, 95p +340ms, memory peak -12%. link: https://ci.example/reports/3670012345

maria: perf numbers look promising. 95p tail still concerning but might be acceptable with fallback mapping.

sam.b: next step: small PoC in staging. i'll wire ensure_phase and a simple fallback to a 7B quantized model. can we get a test bundle with explicit phases? alex?

alex: i can produce a test bundle tomorrow and add prefetch hints for the top 100 prefixes. i'll also add trace spans for each ensure_phase.

lina: i'll add dashboards: per-phase latency, hydration_fallback_rate, and a trace view. also add a query to correlate prefix -> phase access patterns.

kai: one more: think about migration story. if we change phase boundaries, we need bundle compatibility checks. add a manifest version and a phase-uuid so older loaders can detect drift.

alex: noted — will add phase_uuid and manifest_version. thanks all. next: sam.b can you create the staging ticket? i'll attach the test bundle and perf sim. :thumbsup:

sam.b: will do, creating ticket now.

alex: thanks everyone.
